# platform.LogLine

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A structured log line kept in the ring buffer of the local environment for the staff console.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.LogLine` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `platform.trace.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | yes | `none` | Logical environment. |  |
| `fields` | yes | `personal` | The other structured fields of the line. |  |
| `level` | yes | `none` | `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`. |  |
| `message` | yes | `none` | Stable event name of the line. |  |
| `requestId` | yes | `none` | Request the line belongs to, if any. |  |
| `service` | yes | `none` | Service that wrote the line. |  |
| `timestamp` | yes | `none` | When the line was written (UTC). |  |
| `traceId` | yes | `none` | Trace the line belongs to, if any. |  |

## Relations

_None._
